{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print("Number of unique patient_id:", df['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Total number of rows:", len(df))

duplicate_count = (df['patient_id'].duplicated()).sum()
print("Number of duplicate patient_id entries:", duplicate_count)

# Check which patient_ids are duplicated
duplicated_ids = df[df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)]['patient_id'].unique()
print("Duplicated patient_ids:", duplicated_ids[:5])  # Show first 5

# Check sample_seq for duplicates
df_dups = df[df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)]
df_dups_sorted = df_dups.sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq'])
print("\nFor duplicated patients, sample_seq values:")
print(df_dups_sorted[['patient_id', 'sample_seq', 'biomarker_baseline', 'biomarker_final', 'responded']])"}
